data.one_liner: Generate ESC/POS commands to send to thermal printers.
data.what_it_does: Provides core Dart classes to generate ESC/POS command byte arrays for thermal printers. It allows you to format text, tables, images, barcodes, and QR codes into standard printer commands.
use_when: You need to build a custom printing pipeline for thermal printers.
You are creating a receipt printing module using ESC/POS commands.
avoid_when: You are looking for pre-built Bluetooth or Network printer connection wrappers (this package only generates bytes).
You need standard PDF or document printing.
strengths: Supports multiple printer profiles and code tables.
Generates raw byte commands for text, tables, images, and barcodes.
weaknesses: Does not handle network or Bluetooth connectivity directly.
Hardware support varies by thermal printer model.
